verdictChips: Q1 beat: EPS +26.3% vs street, Revenue +13.2% vs street
FMEG: first-ever breakeven quarter — thesis-validating but Q2 seasonality caveat attached
W&C margin: 9.9% actual vs 10.5% FY28 target — management stayed conservative, did not upgrade
Other income +155% QoQ flagged by management itself as non-recurring FX — normalize PAT quality down
Cable-led growth (>25% vol) outpacing wire (~12%) — B2B/cable pivot executing on plan
TTM P/E 47.8x on live CMP, down from 51.8x pre-results despite +3% price pop, on EPS growth outrunning price
Cash conversion (CFO/PAT) at 0.60x FY26 vs 1.59x FY25 — unresolved this quarter, no fresh quarterly cash flow disclosed
